judge.voice: So, I would try it again because it finally kept the two things I actually wanted: a date with different tastes and small talk at a meetup. That feels useful, and the date topic stayed perfectly normal. But “Invalid topic” made me wonder whether asking about dates was the problem. I had to guess and split my request. Then replacing the hotel topic took me through repairs and workspace noise, which wasn't really what I came for.
